pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You're advising a retail brand that runs a loyalty program with 2 million members. They want to build a personalization engine that serves product recommendations in real time — both on their website and inside a weekly email digest. They currently use a third-party CDP (Customer Data Platform) for segmentation and a separate email service provider for sends. Their data science team is small (three people). Walk me through how you would design the architecture for this personalization system, what you would buy versus build, and how you would measure whether the personalization is actually working — keeping in mind that email open and click tracking is increasingly unreliable due to privacy changes like Apple Mail Privacy Protection.
